daily.today_energy: Mercury's got you feeling introspective today, Virgo. Your vibe is giving thoughtful and grounded—perfect energy for untangling what's been on your mind. Trust the clarity that comes naturally.
daily.love: Someone's noticing your authentic self today. Whether you're single or coupled up, vulnerability is your superpower rn. Let people see the real you without overthinking every word.
daily.career: Your attention to detail is hitting different today. Channel that analytical energy into one meaningful project instead of scattered tasks. Quality over quantity—your future self will thank you.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentle movement and good rest. Yoga, walks, or just stretching hits right now. Hydrate more than usual and notice how small rituals make you feel grounded and recharged.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is inviting you to embrace the beauty of imperfection. Mercury's influence is softening your analytical edge, making space for spontaneity and intuition to guide you toward unexpected opportunities.
weekly.love: Your heart's been sending signals you've been too in your head to notice. This week, slow down and listen to what your body's telling you. Whether you're single or coupled up, vulnerability is your superpower right now.
weekly.career: Stop overthinking every detail and trust your gut instincts more. A conversation or collaboration brewing has real potential—lean into it with curiosity rather than caution. Your unique perspective is exactly what's needed.
weekly.health: Your nervous system is asking for gentleness this week. Honor that energy through rest, movement that feels good, or whatever brings you peace. Small, consistent self-care beats grand gestures every time.
